description: West Virginia motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in West Virginia?
questions.explanation: West Virginia has a universal helmet law. Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet.

questions.q: An adult passenger on a motorcycle in West Virginia
questions.explanation: The West Virginia helmet law covers passengers as well as the operator.

questions.q: What does West Virginia law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: West Virginia: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.
questions.remember: West Virginia between lanes: not allowed.

questions.q: In West Virginia, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: West Virginia issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
questions.remember: West Virginia motorcycle permit: 16 years at the earliest.
